name: rich-data-card
description: An enhanced data card with support for descriptions, sections, and actions. Built with React.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title displayed at the top of the card

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description text below the title

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: JSON string of data to display

attributes.name: sections
attributes.description: JSON string of named sections, each with their own data

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Optional icon/emoji to display in the header
